data.description: Embark on a journey of serenity with Zen Garden VR! Step into our virtual realm and immerse yourself in the captivating beauty of Japanese-inspired landscapes. From the majestic pagodas to the iconic Tori Gates, every corner invites you to explore and discover tranquility like never before. 🌸✨ Let the gentle rustle of leaves and the soft murmur of the wind guide you to inner peace in this digital oasis. Whether you seek a moment of relaxation or a path to mindfulness, Zen Garden VR offers a sanctuary for the soul. #ZenGardenVR #VirtualRelaxation #JapaneseSerenity 🌿🌸

changelog.change_log:
Release Notes for Zen Garden VR

Dear Weary Travelers,

Before stepping into this tranquil world, please ensure your field of view is centered, and your guardian boundaries are properly set.

Once inside, take a moment to reset your view once more for the most immersive and harmonious experience. Your journey to serenity begins with preparation.

What’s New in This Update:

Video Intro:
A video plays before the app starts to remind you to centre your view with the Oculus button.

Bug Fixes: Tori Gates are now more centred, walking speed has increased.

The Pagoda Awaits: The once-closed pagoda doors have now opened, welcoming you into its peaceful embrace. Sit by the cosy fire, feel its warmth, and let its gentle glow soothe your spirit.

Day and Night Modes: The Zen Garden now transforms with the passage of time. Bask in the golden hues of the day or let the stillness of the night embrace you under a blanket of stars. Your sanctuary evolves with your mood.

More Scenes Coming Soon: The journey doesn’t end here. New landscapes and meditative experiences are on their way to enrich your escape to tranquility.

Remember, traveler, this is your space to unwind, reflect, and reconnect with the stillness within. Let the whispers of the wind and the crackle of the fire guide you to your Zen.

With Love

K - Zen Garden VR

Urgent Bugfix Release Notes - Version 1.1.0

Release Date: Friday 3rd Jan 2025

We’ve just rolled out an urgent update to address several key fixes and improvements in the game. This update resolves issues and enhances the user experience, including:
Bug Fixes and Updates:

    Controls Fix: The controls have now been fixed and should work as expected, providing smoother and more responsive gameplay.

    Pagoda Temporarily Closed: Due to ongoing updates, the Pagoda is temporarily closed. It will be reopened in the next update, so stay tuned for more content in the near future!

    Snow Has Melted: The snow has melted, revealing a lush, vibrant environment. The garden is now flourishing and looks better than ever!

UI Enhancements:

    UI Menu Update: The UI menu has been enhanced for a more intuitive and visually appealing experience. Navigation and settings are now more streamlined and user-friendly.

Zen Garden VR Update - 1.0.8

Welcome to another exciting update!

Seasonal Change: The snow has stopped and melted, making way for a flourishing and blooming garden.

Day & Night Mode: Experience the garden in both sunlight and moonlight.

Enhanced UI Menu: Enjoy a smoother and more intuitive experience.

If you loved the snow or have suggestions, I’d love to hear from you at hello@future-productions.co.uk.

Don’t worry—snow will return in the next update, along with the ability to toggle it on and off and control other weather aspects. 

Stay tuned & Stay Zen!

- Love & Peace -

Dear friends,

I’m thrilled to share the latest updates for Zen Garden VR! 

Here’s what’s new and what’s coming:

It’s snowing!

For the festive season, I’ve added a beautiful snowfall effect to the garden. Wander through the tranquil paths as snowflakes gently fall around you.

Warm by the fire:

Head to the pagoda and enjoy the cozy fire—a perfect spot to relax and unwind during this chilly season.

Snow as an optional feature:

After the festive period, the snow effect will remain available as an option, so you can enjoy a wintry garden whenever you’d like.

Third Party App Support:

You can now multitask in the app and play music and other meditations from third party sideloaded apps. (Just be sure to mute the in game audio and that you have developer mode enabled. Tested on Quest 2 and up)


Future plans:

I’m already working on adding new places and maps for you to explore. 

Lush forests of bamboo to other hidden gems, there’s much more to look forward to in Zen Garden VR!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback—it means the world to me. I can’t wait to share even more updates with you in the coming months.

Wishing you a peaceful and joyful festive season! 

– Krish

Zen Garden VR - Update 2024

Thank you all for enjoying Zen Garden so far!

It has been a tricky time for me but I have finally managed a new update for you to enjoy.

1) The pagoda is now open, feel free to warm yourself by the fire.
2) Textures on the Tori Gates have been improved.
3) Web browsing and some 2D Android apps will work from within this app on Quest 2 and up!

Thanks for your support on this journey. I am very proud to help you all relax with this app.

Stay tuned for more updates out soon!

K

A guided meditation has now been added. The vocals have been enhanced to bring about a deeper sense of relaxation. The Zen garden will be getting new updates again soon with a new meditation each month and other new features.
The garden has grown! May it help you explore and find peace.
Requested changes added. Player style has been changed to Roomscale and Standing.
